'''Xivhkalrainik''', known to others as '''Xalek''', and derogatorily referred to as '''bone-face''' by Overseer [[Harkun]], was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] and the [[war against Zakuul]]. Apprenticed to [[Darth Nox]] of the [[Dark Council]], Xalek rose to the rank of Sith Lord following his master's disappearance during the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|war of conquest]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My great-great grandfather and two of his wives led an outnumbered force to victory in the great clan wars. Our family prays at their shrine still.|Xalek|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] named Xivhkalrainik was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> where he learned many things about his people's culture, his [[Xivhkalrainik's family|family]]'s history, and the prospects of becoming a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]].

He once fought the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] along the coastline of the [[Jenuwaa Sea]] but was captured. He was initially sent into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], but shortly afterwards the Empire discovered that he was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and instead sent him to the [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] to undergo training and make him a powerful [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

Xalek was the name [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseer]] [[Harkun]] gave the Kaleesh as the [[Human/Legends|Human]] couldn't understand Xalek's name in his [[Kaleesh (language)|native language]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Xalek was also responsible for the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of two fellow acolytes before they arrived, and apparently got away with it. Though his group was passed up by [[Darth Thanaton]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], the future Darth Nox, was interested in gaining a new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] after their previous two were massacred by Thanaton, especially since having a Korriban acolyte was a sign of prestige. Kallig, who had also risen from slavery to become a Sith Lord, was very interested in the Kaleesh, and even bet with Harkun that he would rise above the other acolytes.

Xalek passed through his trials, but when it became apparent that the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Seferiss]] was going to be chosen, Xalek simply walked up and brutally punched him to death, then looted his body for the required item&mdash;a Sith carving artifact&mdash;and presented it to Kallig. Harkun was displeased with this, as acolytes were forbidden to kill each other and decided to pass Xalek up. Kallig took Xalek anyway, and executed Harkun when he remained defiant.

Xalek was not his master's first apprentice; the former Jedi [[Ashara Zavros]] and Kallig's two deceased apprentices&mdash;[[Corrin (Sith Empire)|Corrin]] and [[Kaal (Human)|Kaal]]&mdash;were all apprenticed to Kallig. However, Xalek was the first that Kallig trained and personally taught in the ways of the Sith, as Ashara was mentored by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Ryen]] and [[Ocera]] before Kallig killed them and she remained a Jedi disciple despite now serving a Sith. Corrin and Kaal were trained by [[Darth Zash]] beforehand, but killed by Thanaton before Kallig could instruct them further.

As Xalek served his master, he revealed a bit about his history, searched for artifacts of power, and killed Kallig's rivals. Xalek somehow kept in contact with his father, who passed away on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during his son's apprenticeship to Kallig. Xalek was allowed to give his father a proper burial so he could ascend to godhood. Xalek eventually considered Kallig a living god and a "father" or "mother" and promised to serve Kallig to death and guard his master's legacy.

After his master disappeared during the initial stages of the war against the [[Eternal Empire]], Xalek honed his skills during this chaotic period and was made a Lord of the Sith. He eventually visited his father's shrine on Ilum, to discover it had been desecrated by miners. Enraged, Xalek began a campaign of terror and revenge against them, eventually coming face to face with [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]], who had come to investigate the miners' distress call on behalf of [[Sana-Rae]].<ref name="Dishonor">{{TORcite|type=general|Death Before Dishonor|Ilum}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|There's something vaguely unsettling about Bone-Face. He's hardly said a word. But he's got a determined glint in his eye. Reminds me of you.|Overseer Harkun to Lord Kallig|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Xalek was described as a wild animal, his only comprehensive understanding of the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|Sith code]] being "kill or be killed." He enjoyed fighting and killing, even against overwhelming odds, preferring to let his actions speak rather than words. Likewise, Xalek despised any form of mercy or weakness.

As a Kaleesh, Xalek felt that "honor is [his] duty." Thus, he was very determined to uphold his culture and family's legacy by becoming Kallig's apprentice, even going so far as to kill three of the other five acolytes during his training on Korriban, letting nothing stop him in achieving his goal.

He was faithfully loyal to anyone he considered his family. When he heard his father was dying, Xalek rushed to his side and gave his father a proper burial. Xalek was very formal to Kallig, addressing Kallig as "Master" or "Lord" and occasionally bowing. He often asked how he could serve his master, such as killing all of Kallig's rivals. However, despite Xalek's utter loyalty, he sometimes suggested that he would one day rise above Kallig.

Xalek's insistence on remaining honorable even while fighting any and all opponents to the death was likely an earnest attempt to reconcile the Sith code's extreme social opportunism with the Kaleesh warrior culture. He combined the fierce, brutal lightsaber combat and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] powers of the Sith with his own warrior instincts, caring little for the deceptive and subtle ways most Inquisitors resorted to. Harkun lamented this, complaining that the Empire could not last if subterfuge and discretion gave way to outright murder. However, as Kallig demonstrated, his opinion mattered little to Xalek.

It was his stated desire to become a god when he died, and he felt he required training as a Sith in order to do this. He also had a strong admiration for the Sith, telling his master that the Kaleesh considered the Sith to be gods who had not yet died.

Xalek disliked talking and extended conversations and was concise whenever he spoke. When he spoke, it was only because his actions could not better get his point across. His actions were likewise blunt and to the point. He thus appreciated when his master used brevity and direct action rather than talking conflicts out. This was shown when Kallig asked about his great-great grandfather having multiple wives; Xalek did not provide an explanation and simply replied "Of course," apparently unable to see why this might be a problem for other species. Kallig noted this trait, stating that Xalek didn't "waste words."

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:Xivhkalrainik.png|thumb|Xalek as a Sith Lord]]
Like his master, Xalek was a [[Sith Inquisitor]]. He was a practitioner of the [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] technique, suggesting he chose the [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]] training path. In addition to his brutal melee attacks, he was an adept Force user, wielding powerful dark-side techniques such as [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], [[Force Shockwave|Force bomb]], and [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barrier]]. Unlike Kallig's other companions with the exception of [[Khem Val]], who specialized in either offensive or defensive combat techniques, Xalek specialized in both.

==Behind the scenes==
Xalek is one of the companion players open to players who choose to play as the [[Sith Inquisitor]] Class in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.

The ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Classes app lists his main weapon as a polesaber; this is another name for a [[Lightsaber pike/Legends|lightsaber pike]].

It is also possible for Kallig to persuade Harkun to forget the murder and hand Xalek his lightsaber or just let him walk away.

Xalek is a prospective recruit for the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] against the Eternal Empire in the ''Knights of the Fallen Empire'' storyline. The player is dispatched by the Alliance to track Xalek down and end the killing, to secure the mined resources for the Alliance. The Outlander must decide how to handle Xalek's grievance against the miners: they can negotiate a deal with the miners to rebuild the shrine for light side points, arrest Xalek, also for light side points, or they can let Xalek kill the last of them for dark side points. With the miners dealt with, Xalek can be recruited. If the player is a Sith Inquisitor, Xalek will choose to follow his former master of his own free will, and join the Alliance. If the player is not an Inquisitor, they must first fight Xalek before choosing to recruit him. The player&mdash;even as an Inquisitor&mdash;also has the option of rejecting him as a member of the Alliance, or even killing him.<ref name="Dishonor" /> If the Outlander later aligns with the Republic, Xalek will warn that while he respected the Outlander's strength and would remain in the Alliance, this may not always be the case.<ref name="Republic Side">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=message|I am Sith|Xalek}}</ref>
